description: This file defines an Express.js router for handling CRUD operations on LLM Cost records. It includes middleware for tenant enforcement, authentication, and route-specific behaviors, as well as Swagger documentation for API endpoints.

classes.name: Object (from express.Router())
classes.description: Express.js Router object used to define route handlers for LLM cost endpoints.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handler for GET /api/llm-costs; returns a list of LLM cost records with tenant scoping enforcement.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handler for GET /api/llm-costs/:id; retrieves a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handler for POST /api/llm-costs; creates a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handler for PUT /api/llm-costs/:id; updates an existing LLM cost record.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handler for DELETE /api/llm-costs/:id; deletes an LLM cost record.
